name: Civic Senate & Democratic Republic
description: Overthrow absolute monarchy to establish an elected civic senate, tribunes, and citizen assemblies.
creativePrompt: Who holds the franchise to vote? What constitutional checks prevent a dictator from seizing power?
exampleNarrative: In the open-air curia, elected consuls and citizen tribunes passed laws by majority vote, casting away royal crowns.

name: Codified Common Law & Courts
description: Inscribe universal civil and criminal laws onto bronze pillars placed in every public square.
creativePrompt: What punishments and compensations are laid down for theft, breach of contract, and treason?
exampleNarrative: Bronze stelae inscribed with three hundred laws were unveiled in every forum: justice now applied equally to noble and peasant.

name: Merchant & Craft Guild Leagues
description: Charter guildhalls regulating apprenticeships, hallmark quality standards, and continental trade monopolies.
creativePrompt: What secret masterwork must an apprentice smith or weaver craft to earn the title of Guildmaster?
exampleNarrative: Guild stamps guaranteed the purity of silver and the temper of steel, making the city hallmark trusted in every market.

name: Deep Shaft Adit Mining & Waterwheels
description: Construct waterwheel-driven bucket lines and drainage adits to delve thousands of feet into rich mineral lodes.
creativePrompt: What strange subterranean gas or creatures did miners discover in the deepest pits?
exampleNarrative: Giant waterwheels powered drainage pumps day and night, opening fathom-deep veins of copper and coal once deemed unworkable.

name: Navigational Astrolabe & Cartography
description: Engineer precision brass astrolabes and trigonometric map projections for accurate world atlases.
creativePrompt: What forgotten continents and sea trenches were first mapped using the new brass instruments?
exampleNarrative: With brass astrolabes sighting the Pole Star, navigators drew the first true latitude lines across the world ocean.

name: Clinical Medicine & Pharmacopoeia
description: Found public infirmaries and compile empirical medical treatises on surgery, fever treatments, and antiseptics.
creativePrompt: How did hygienic surgery and herbal antiseptics double the life expectancy of common folk?
exampleNarrative: Trained chirurgeons boiled their instruments in alcohol and washed wounds with vinegar, curbing the spread of plague.

name: Golden Age of Drama & Poetry
description: Patronize public stone amphitheatres, tragic plays, epic choral odes, and realistic marble sculptures.
creativePrompt: Which legendary hero or heartbreak was dramatized in the great annual dramatic competition?
exampleNarrative: Ten thousand spectators wept together in the stone amphitheatre as actors in painted masks performed the fall of the first kings.

name: Astral Observatory & Arcane Synthesis
description: Synthesize empirical mathematics and high magic to chart the planetary ley lines and avert planar cataclysms.
creativePrompt: What impending planar convergence was calculated by the astronomical mages?
exampleNarrative: Prisms of starlight split into raw arcane equations upon the observatory floor, calculating the movements of the gods.
